radial_scale.zero_semantics: Valid source values; displayed at the geometric origin without jitter
radial_scale.unknown_reference_offset: The reference may use central padding, but it cannot be established from permitted image evidence. No offset is inferred or fitted.

colors.provenance: Visual estimates supplied in independent reference reading; not recovered author settings

data_transformations: Map labels, reorder spokes/methods, and convert supplied radius to Cartesian drawing coordinates. No normalization, filtering, imputation, jitter, aggregation, or recomputation.
statistical_layers: Supplied acceptance rates only; no new hypothesis tests or uncertainty estimates
intentional_differences: One standalone panel with direct cell-class labels and a two-row method legend replaces the shared whole-figure key.
The radial origin is explicitly zero; unknown reference origin padding is not inferred, so valid zeros overlap at the center.
A single-panel title replaces the reference frame around a two-chart depot group.
All text is 8 pt. Relative marker and margin sizes are adapted to a readable 88 mm square panel.
